**Download `deck-tools.zip` below** and attach it to a Claude chat in your Project when you build a deck (and in outline chats if you want linting). It holds the linter, fragment drafter, assembler, checker, notes writer, runtime, tag and layout registries, and style CSS. Its `README-BUNDLE.md` has the commands; `MANIFEST.json` lists every file with its SHA-256 and the commit it came from.

- Setup: [README](https://github.com/terrytompkins/outline-to-deck#quick-start)
- Everything else: [docs/REFERENCE.md](https://github.com/terrytompkins/outline-to-deck/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.md)
- What changed: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/terrytompkins/outline-to-deck/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Built decks load Reveal.js 6.0.2 and Mermaid 12.3.0 from CDNs, with SRI hashes and a fallback CDN.
